DEFINE INSTRUMENT sesans_rebuild (
L0 = 2.165, // AA] Wavelength centre
DL = 0.02, // AA] Wavelength spread
By = 0.00468 // T] Magnetic field By
)

DECLARE 
%{
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated sesans_rebuild
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
 yheight = 0.01, xwidth = 0.01,
 dist = 2.25, focus_xw = 0.01,
 focus_yh = 0.01, lambda0 = L0,
 dlambda = DL, gauss = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT set_pol = Set_pol(
 px = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.1) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT px1 = PolLambda_monitor(
 nL = 501, restore_neutron = 1,
 filename = "px1.dat", mx = 1,
 Lmin = L0-DL, Lmax = L0+DL)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.01) RELATIVE set_pol

COMPONENT f1 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.1,
 zdepth = 0.3, phi = 0.095993,
 foilthick = 3, Bx = 0,
 By = By, Bz = 0,
 foil_in = 1, verbose = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.5) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT px2 = PolLambda_monitor(
 nL = 501, restore_neutron = 1,
 filename = "px2.dat", mx = 1,
 Lmin = L0-DL, Lmax = L0+DL)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.16) RELATIVE f1

COMPONENT f2 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.1,
 zdepth = 0.3, phi = 0.095993,
 foilthick = 3, Bx = 0,
 By = By, Bz = 0,
 foil_in = 1, verbose = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT px3 = PolLambda_monitor(
 nL = 501, restore_neutron = 1,
 filename = "px3.dat", mx = 1,
 Lmin = L0-DL, Lmax = L0+DL)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.16) RELATIVE f2

COMPONENT sans_spheres = SANS_spheres2(
 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.02,
 zthick = 0.001, dsdw_inc = 0,
 sc_aim = 0.8, sans_aim = 0.95,
 R = 10000, phi = 0.015,
 singlesp = 0, Qmind = 3e-05,
 Qmaxd = 0.001)
WHEN (1==1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.25) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT f3 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.1,
 zdepth = 0.3, phi = 0.095993,
 foilthick = 3, Bx = 0,
 By = By, Bz = 0,
 foil_in = 1, verbose = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.5) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT f4 = Foil_flipper_magnet(
 xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.1,
 zdepth = 0.3, phi = 0.095993,
 foilthick = 3, Bx = 0,
 By = By, Bz = 0,
 foil_in = 1, verbose = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT px6 = PolLambda_monitor(
 nL = 501, restore_neutron = 1,
 filename = "px6.dat", mx = 1,
 Lmin = L0-DL, Lmax = L0+DL)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.16) RELATIVE f4

COMPONENT ana = PolAnalyser_ideal(
 mx = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.4) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 101, ny = 101,
 filename = "det.dat", xwidth = 0.011,
 yheight = 0.011)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.5) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT trick = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.4) RELATIVE src
EXTEND %{
RESTORE_NEUTRON(INDEX_CURRENT_COMP-2,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,t,sx,sy,sz,p);
%}

COMPONENT ana2 = PolAnalyser_ideal(
 mx = -1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.4) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det2 = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 101, ny = 101,
 filename = "det2.dat", xwidth = 0.011,
 yheight = 0.011)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.5) RELATIVE src

FINALLY 
%{
// Start of finally for generated sesans_rebuild
%}

END
"}
